risks.title: Dependence on franchise agreements with The Coca-Cola Company
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk to the business model (Item 1A, page 43 referenced). CCEP operates entirely under bottler agreements with TCCC; moderate language but high structural criticality. Stable trend but major categorical weight for business viability.

risks.title: Macroeconomic volatility and inflationary pressure on costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a key factor (page 11: 'complex macroeconomic landscape marked by geopolitical volatility, legislative changes, and inflationary pressures'). Direct and repeated language; direct impact on margins and pricing strategy. Trend up (persistent inflation).

risks.title: Intensifying competition and pressure on market share
risks.score_rationale: Implied in growth strategy and positioning (pages 7-11). Strong competitive language ('number one value creator', 'top supplier'). Trend up: increasing competition in energy (Monster), ARTD and health beverages. High categorical weight for FMCG sector.

risks.title: Regulatory risks related to sugar taxes and health legislation
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned (page 3: 'recent increase in sugar taxes'). Direct language; quantifiable impact on volumes. Trend up: multiplication of sugar taxes in Europe and Asia-Pacific. Major categorical weight for beverage sector.

risks.title: Supply chain risks and dependence on critical suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Implied in business model (pages 9-10: sourcing of ingredients and packaging). Moderate language but structural risk. Trend up: geopolitical volatility affecting global supply. Medium-high categorical weight for manufacturing operations.

risks.title: Digital transformation risks and technological dependency (SAP, AI)
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned as a major strategic investment (page 8: '~1 billion invested... digital transformation through SAP S/4HANA and new Integrated Shared Services centre'). Positive language but high implementation risk. Trend new/up: transformation ongoing. Growing categorical weight.

risks.title: Environmental risks and ambitious sustainability targets
risks.score_rationale: Integrated into 'This is Forward' strategy (pages 5, 26). Ambitious language (GHG reduction 18.9%, recycling collection 75.7%, water 105.2%). Trend stable but increasing weight. Risk: failure to meet targets or high compliance costs.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and exposure to volatile emerging markets
risks.score_rationale: Implied in diversified portfolio (31 markets, Asia-Pacific, Indonesia mentioned on page 3). Moderate language but real exposure. Trend up: increasing geopolitical tensions. Medium categorical weight for balanced portfolio.

ai_positioning.summary: CCEP integrates AI as a lever for operational efficiency and consumer analytics, without positioning it as a core product differentiation driver. Focus is on leveraging data to optimize supply chain and marketing campaigns.
